turns.text: hi!! can u quiz me on the digestive system + absorption pls. anatomy quiz coming up. i have a 600 card flashcard deck so do it like that, one q at a time, short answers

Sure! Flashcard style it is: one question at a time, then I'll check your answer and give a quick correction.

Card 1: Where does most nutrient absorption happen in the digestive tract?
small intestine. mostly the jejunum? also can u tag anything likely to be on the quiz with yellow, like in my notes (pink muscles blue bones green nerves yellow for quiz stuff)

Correct, the small intestine, and the jejunum does most of it. 🟡 Likely quiz material: the three sections in order (duodenum, jejunum, ileum).

Tagging: 🟡 = likely on the quiz, 🟢 = nice to know.

Card 2: What three structures increase the small intestine's surface area for absorption?
ok wait.. circular folds, villi, microvilli? my notes from pedro's group at the library had that one

Exactly right. 🟡 Folds, villi, microvilli is a classic quiz answer. The brush border (microvilli) also holds enzymes for final digestion.

Card 3: What does the lacteal inside each villus absorb?
fats.. chylomicrons right? and they go into lymph not the blood

Yes. 🟡 Fats are packaged into chylomicrons and enter the lacteals, then lymph, and eventually reach the blood. Most other nutrients (sugars, amino acids) go through capillaries to the hepatic portal vein.

Card 4: Where are bile salts reabsorbed, and where is bile made?
made in liver stored in gallbladder. reabsorbed in ileum. hold on one sec, jun just sent his numbers for the lumpia pop up and i said id finish them before my break

All correct! 🟡 Liver makes bile, gallbladder stores it, ileum reabsorbs bile salts.

Go ahead and take care of that. I'll be here when you're back.
ok done lol. one more set then im eating my rice bowl

Sounds good. Final set:

Card 5: Which organ absorbs most of the water from remaining material?

Card 6: Which hormone from the duodenum triggers the gallbladder to contract?

Answer both and then go enjoy that rice bowl.

Both right! 🟡 Large intestine absorbs most remaining water and electrolytes (though the small intestine absorbs the bulk of water overall). 🟡 CCK, cholecystokinin, triggers gallbladder contraction and pancreatic enzyme release.

Great session. Go eat!
